video-matte.usage: Video player background and video-section ground; dark matte that recedes behind the art.

on-matte.usage: Text and icons on video-matte fills (11.8:1). Never near-black on matte.

on-teal-deep.usage: Text and icons on teal-deep fills where near-black would muddy the hue.

teal-glow.usage: Soft teal glow behind active states and the hero's ambient rings; illustration and UI accent only, never text.

status-bg.usage: Status chip and pill backgrounds; same value as surface-raised but reserved for status semantics.

status-ink.usage: Text on status-bg and other light status grounds (12:1).

mark-claude.usage: Claude wordmark and icon accent in the agents gallery; brand colour of the model, used as-is.

mark-deepseek.usage: DeepSeek wordmark and icon accent in the agents gallery; brand colour of the model, used as-is.

mark-openai.usage: OpenAI wordmark and icon accent in the agents gallery; brand colour of the model, used as-is.

proof-flag-bg.usage: Proof-flag and badge backgrounds; cream, same as the cream token but reserved for proof semantics.

print-ink.usage: Ink for print stylesheets and exported artefacts; near-black on white.

ai-soon-ink.usage: Muted ink for AI features marked Coming soon; same value as ink-muted but reserved for AI-soon semantics.
